levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Two branches (ح) meet at موسى الجهني, written in each; the tail after him is written once, Mus'ab, then his father Sa'd (a relation, as the report never names him), who relays the Prophet's words; the asker among the companions is in the scene; «- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss, left out
